test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On: 25 May 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: B Herambanathan who was awarded with the ‘Sangeet Natak Akademi Award’ in 2013 is a _________ dancer.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bharatanatyam.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **B. Herambanathan is a Bharatanatyam artist and dance director.**
 
• He** founded "Thanjavur Bhavupillai Bharatanatyam School**" in Thanjavur.
 
• He composed dance dramas like **Shakunthalam in Marathi, Rukmini Kalyanam in Telugu, Harishchandra, Andal Kalyanam in Tamil.**
 
• He has written articles on many subjects like Bharatanatyam, Bhagavata Melam, Rasapandaram, Thanjavur dance tradition.
 
• He runs Thanjavur Heritage Arts and Cultural Academy.
 
• Tamil Isai Sangam awarded him titles like **"Natyakalai Arasu", "Nattuva Mamani".**
 
• Tamil Aiyal Isai Nataka Manram honored him with theKalaimamaniaward.
 
• He was awarded with** Sangeet Natak Akademi Award in Bharatanatyam in 2013.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bharatanatyam** is a major form of Indian classical dance that** originated in Tamil Nadu.**
 
• The dance form is also briefly mentioned in Kannada text Manasollasa written by Someshwara III.
 
• It has flourished in the temples and courts of southern India since ancient times.
 
• It is one of the eight widely recognized Indian classical dance forms.
 
• **Savitha Sastry** is an Indian dancer and choreographer best known as an **exponent of Bharatanatyam.**
